info.name: SprintLabs Dashboard - Seeded End-to-End Tests
info.description: Run the whole collection with SprintLabs Demo Local environment, one iteration. Set seedPassword locally first. Automatically logs in owner and two seeded teachers; discovers IDs; validates exact frontend fields, paging, permissions, class mutations, teacher edits/messages; restores seeded teacher profile/assignments and archives its own temporary class. One unread message plus audit records persist each run. Optional invitation lifecycle sends email only when runEmailInvitationTests=true and invitationEmail is set to a disposable test mailbox. No seeded teacher is removed. Tokens stay run-local. See README.md.
